alleys.note: 20' strip from Colerain south along the west side of the Lodge & Shipley lot to Garrard Av. (not open); lower end taken at the centreline of the unopened Garrard

bends.note: Colerain begins to curve more steeply south-west toward the west edge of the sheet (centre ~y 1423 at the edge x 130)
Garrard narrows from 60' to 25' with a small jog; east of here it runs 25'/20'/30' to Hopple on a slightly steeper line

ends.note: open 60' section west of Elam stops against the Lodge & Shipley machine shop and crane runway
printed 'GARRARD AV. (NOT OPEN)': unopened platted section from the west edge of the sheet to the 20' alley / Lodge & Shipley lot line; not continuous with the open section

notes: Sheet drawn with north to the left: Colerain along the top, Hopple down the right side, Spring Grove along the bottom. Names printed 'COLERAIN AV.', 'ELAM AV.', 'GARRARD AV.', 'HOPPLE', 'MEEKER', 'AVON PL.', 'SPRING GROVE AV.', 'JESSAMINE ST.', 'TERRACE PL.'; HOPPLE and MEEKER have no suffix and are recorded as Street. Jessamine St. and Terrace Pl. are only stubs east of Hopple (they run onto sheet 281). The street east of Hopple opposite Garrard is unnamed here; it is Garrard Av. on sheet 281 (45'), so Garrard/Hopple is a cross (Garrard is 30' on this side). Colerain/Hopple centreline crossing is just off the top of the sheet. Spring Grove's south line is not drawn on this sheet; its centreline is taken 50 ft (about 300 px) south of the north building line using the printed 100' width; Spring Grove bends at Hopple (rises eastward of Hopple). Meeker is shown continuing west of Avon Pl. only as a dashed (unopened) south line, so Avon/Meeker is treated as a T. Garrard width varies: 60' west part, 25' and 20' near x 4150-4650, 30' at Hopple.
